blocks.text: When planning a home renovation, homeowners often look to designers, architects, and online sources for inspiration. But bringing that vision to life takes more intentional planning, from the layout of the home to the interiors and elements that shape how the family uses and experiences the space every day. Carrier, the authority in air solutions, made inspiration a tangible experience when it opened the doors of its three-day pop-up, the Carrier Home Design Studio, at Uptown Mall, BGC. The event invited homeowners and designers to reimagine modern living and cooling with the brand’s floor-standing aircon, Carrier Slim. “Times have changed, and […]...
